male.name: External Human Body Reference (Male Reference · BodyParts3D 4.0 / DBCLS CC BY 4.0)
male.structuralDescription: Complete adult external human surface geometry with cranial, facial, clavicular, pectoral, abdominal, upper-limb, and lower-limb surface landmarks.

male.name: Skull: Cranium, Zygomatic Arch, Maxilla & Mandible
male.structuralDescription: Neurocranium (frontal, parietal, temporal, occipital bones) and viscerocranium (zygomatic arches, maxilla, and hinged mandible).

male.name: Vertebral Column (Cervical C1–C7, Thoracic T1–T12, Lumbar L1–L5 & Sacrum)
male.structuralDescription: 24 articulating presacral vertebrae, intervertebral fibrocartilage discs, and fused sacrum protecting the spinal cord.

male.name: Sternum (Manubrium, Sternal Body & Xiphoid Process)
male.structuralDescription: Anterior midline flat bone of the thorax articulating with the clavicles and costal cartilages of ribs 1–7.

male.name: Thoracic Rib Cage (Costal Arches 1–10 & Hyaline Costal Cartilage)
male.structuralDescription: Bilateral true, false, and floating ribs with anterior hyaline costal cartilage enclosing and protecting the heart, lungs, and liver.

male.name: Pectoral Shoulder Girdle (Left & Right Clavicles & Scapulae)
male.structuralDescription: Collarbones (clavicles) and shoulder blades (scapulae) connecting the upper limbs to the axial skeleton.

male.name: Upper Limb Skeleton (Humerus, Radius, Ulna, Carpals & Metacarpals)
male.structuralDescription: Brachial humerus, antebrachial radius and ulna, and articulated carpal, metacarpal, and phalangeal bones of both hands.

male.name: Pelvic Girdle (Ilium, Iliac Crest, Ischium, Pubic Symphysis & Acetabulum)
male.structuralDescription: Bilateral os coxae (ilium, ischium, and pubis) joined anteriorly at the pubic symphysis and posteriorly with the sacrum.

male.name: Femur & Patella (Femoral Head, Greater Trochanter, Shaft, Condyles & Kneecap)
male.structuralDescription: Longest, strongest load-bearing cortical bone of the human skeleton articulating at the hip acetabulum and knee joint.

male.name: Tibia, Fibula, Talus, Calcaneus & Metatarsal Foot Skeleton
male.structuralDescription: Medial weight-bearing tibia, lateral fibula, ankle mortise, calcaneal heel bone, and longitudinal/transverse metatarsal arches.

male.name: Sternocleidomastoid, Scalenes & Masticatory Masseter Muscles
male.structuralDescription: Paired sternocleidomastoid muscles rotating and flexing the head, alongside jaw-closing masseter and temporalis muscles.

male.name: Pectoralis Major (Clavicular & Sternocostal Fan-Shaped Chest Muscles)
male.structuralDescription: Thick, fan-shaped anterior chest muscle adducting, flexing, and internally rotating the humerus at the shoulder joint.

male.name: Deltoid Muscles (Anterior, Lateral & Posterior Shoulder Heads)
male.structuralDescription: Multipennate shoulder muscle capping the glenohumeral joint and serving as the primary abductor of the upper arm.

male.name: Biceps Brachii, Triceps Brachii & Brachioradialis Forearm Muscles
male.structuralDescription: Anterior elbow flexors (biceps brachii, brachialis), posterior elbow extensor (triceps brachii), and forearm grip flexors/extensors.

male.name: Rectus Abdominis (with Tendinous Inscriptions), External Obliques & Serratus Anterior
male.structuralDescription: Paired strap muscles divided by the midline linea alba and three transverse tendinous inscriptions, flanked by external obliques.

male.name: Trapezius, Latissimus Dorsi, Rhomboids & Erector Spinae Back Muscles
male.structuralDescription: Diamond-shaped trapezius stabilizing the scapula and broad latissimus dorsi extending and adducting the humerus.

male.name: Quadriceps Femoris (Rectus Femoris, Vastus Lateralis, Vastus Medialis & Intermedius)
male.structuralDescription: Four-headed anterior thigh extensor complex converging into the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament to extend the knee.

male.name: Gastrocnemius, Soleus (Triceps Surae), Achilles Tendon & Tibialis Anterior
male.structuralDescription: Plantarflexor calf muscles (gastrocnemius and soleus) inserting via the calcaneal Achilles tendon, paired with the dorsiflexor tibialis anterior.

male.name: Brain (Left & Right Cerebral Hemispheres, Cerebellum, Brainstem & Spinal Cord)
male.structuralDescription: Telencephalic cerebral cortex, diencephalon, cerebellum, brainstem, and spinal cord.

male.name: Eyes & Optic Pathways (Sclera, Cornea, Iris, Retina & Optic Nerves)
male.structuralDescription: Bilateral ocular globes housed in the bony orbits with transparent cornea, iris, crystalline lens, photoreceptor retina, and cranial nerve II.

male.name: Thyroid Butterfly Gland (Left & Right Lobes, Isthmus & Parathyroids)
male.structuralDescription: Bilobed cervical endocrine gland anterior to the trachea synthesizing thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) from dietary iodine.

male.name: Spleen, Thymus & Lymphatic Immune Organs
male.structuralDescription: Primary mediastinal T-cell maturation organ (thymus) and left-hypochondriac lymphoid filtration organ (spleen).

male.name: Lungs (Right 3-Lobe Lung, Left 2-Lobe Lung with Cardiac Notch) & Trachea
male.structuralDescription: Cartilaginous trachea bifurcating at the carina into the right and left pulmonary lobes.

male.name: Heart (Left & Right Ventricles, Atria, Coronary Sulcus & Aortic Arch)
male.structuralDescription: Four-chambered muscular pump in the middle mediastinum with left-oriented apex, ascending aorta, aortic arch, and pulmonary trunk.

male.name: Systemic Aorta, Vena Cava, Carotid & Iliac/Femoral Vascular Tree
male.structuralDescription: Descending thoracic and abdominal aorta, superior and inferior vena cava, common carotid arteries, and common iliac/femoral trunks.

male.name: Liver (Right & Left Hepatic Lobes) & Gallbladder
male.structuralDescription: Largest metabolic visceral organ in the right upper quadrant beneath the diaphragm, paired with the bile-storing gallbladder.

male.name: Stomach (Cardia, Fundus, Body & Pylorus), Duodenum & Pancreas
male.structuralDescription: J-shaped muscular gastric chamber performing enzymatic and acid digestion, C-loop duodenum, and retroperitoneal exocrine/endocrine pancreas.

male.name: Small Intestine (Jejunum & Ileum) & Haustrated Colon (Ascending, Transverse, Descending & Sigmoid)
male.structuralDescription: Nutrient-absorbing small intestinal coils framed by the cecum, ascending, transverse, descending, and sigmoid colon.

male.name: Left & Right Kidneys (Renal Cortex, Medulla, Pelvis) & Ureters
male.structuralDescription: Retroperitoneal bean-shaped kidneys filtering blood plasma to regulate fluid-electrolyte homeostasis.
